snippet.title: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
The Future Games Show Spring Showcase let the curtains fall with the reveal of Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy. This is the third entry in Stormind Games' story-driven survival horror series, and t's coming to PC and consoles later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3335310/Remothered_Red_Nuns_Legacy

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
